description: This Java source file defines the 'DisplayActivity' class for an Android application. It manages UI fragments to display Picasa's featured images, handles screen modes and navigation, and responds to broadcast messages for downloading images and displaying zoomed-in views.

classes.name: DownloadStateReceiver
classes.description: Handles broadcast messages related to the download status of images, updating fragment UI components accordingly.

classes.name: FragmentDisplayer
classes.description: Responds to broadcasts to display images or zoom views by managing fragments dynamically.

methods.name: setFullScreen
methods.description: Configures the activity's display to full-screen mode or standard mode, adjusting window flags and UI visibility.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Handles fragment back stack changes, especially to disable full-screen mode when navigating back.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current fullscreen state before activity destruction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, registers broadcast receivers, and adds initial fragment.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters receivers and cleans up resources upon activity destruction.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops background threads related to image management.
